evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; the required growth-atmosphere measurement is unavailable.
Growth pressure was 3.045 Torr at 99.5 sccm Ar.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.338 Torr despite essentially constant Ar flow; no pressure target, tolerance, or normal-run reference is supplied.
Temperature is 749.5 °C against 750 °C and Ar is 99.1 sccm against 100 sccm; controller reports running, but these cannot verify atmosphere integrity.

args.missing_evidence: A validated exhaust O2 measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; pressure acceptance limits and an independent pressure/exhaust-path check would resolve the rising-pressure concern. No sample characterization is available.
